description: Returns the composite CEFI (Crypto ETF Flow Index): a 0–100 index of money moving through US spot crypto ETFs on all 16 tracked assets. Net flows of all funds are added up in dollars, and three components are scored against the past year: flow (today's net flow, smoothed, 40%), trend (net flow over 20 trading days, 30%) and breadth (share of funds with inflows, 30%). 50 = zero net flow; a typical inflow day scores about 69, a typical outflow day about 31. Each component is on the same 0–100 scale. Zones: 0–20 extreme fear, 20–40 fear, 40–60 neutral, 60–80 greed, 80–100 extreme greed.
name: get_cefi_index
title: CEFI Sentiment Index
